headline: Argentina Balances Fiscal Targets and Subsidies as Inflation Pressures Persist
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo adjusted utility rate hikes for November by boosting subsidies, as the government and central bank warned of ongoing inflation pressures from meat, fuel, and tariffs.
why: Argentine utility subsidies and price adjustments directly affect the country's fiscal deficit and inflation rate under President Javier Milei's administration.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Utility tariff adjustments and subsidy spending directly impact household costs and the sovereign fiscal deficit.
